exposure: high doses of flecainide and digoxin combination treatment
outcome: Time to arrhythmia and hydrops resolution
cohort: 20 fetuses diagnosed with hydrops fetalis and fetal tachyarrhythmia at the University Hospital of Wales
finding: High-dose flecainide and digoxin combination treatment resulted in a 90% tachycardia response rate and favorable outcomes in fetuses with hydrops and tachyarrhythmia.
mod_finding: One fetus in the study underwent an early cesarean delivery due to worsening hydrops.
